messages:
leah: Quick thread to capture decisions we talked about in the sync. We need a concrete playbook for v1->v2 route migration that balances customer safety, engineering effort, and infra cost. I sketched a per-surface checklist below. Comments?
mike: Nice. Ieel we should keep the public-facing UX minimal: one Console toggle per-account for "compatibility mode" and a per-route override. Internally we need feature flags to route traffic and a transition state machine.
oliver: Infra constraints: dual-serving (v1 & v2) for embeddings is the heavy hitter. If we allow long-lived pinning we need cold storage for old model checkpoints + memory footprint. Estimate: supporting 50 pinned hosted tenants => +2x GPU fleet for embeddings peak.
ting: Per-surface checklist (suggested):
- embeddings: migration harness, client-side reindex script, parity validation (cosine & rank), pinned compatibility TTL policy;
- structured output: schema diffs tool, auto-validate pipeline with sample-size gating, and schema-strict mode that returns errors instead of best-effort attempts;
- tool/function-calling: compatibility adapter library in SDK + server-side adapter as fallback; include typed contracts and error-mapping;
- chat/completions: semantic regression suite (BLEU-like + human spot-check), adjustable temperature/decoding knobs to reduce behavior delta.
priya: Customer expectations: Enterprise customers will ask for contract language: guaranteed migration assistance + limited rollback windows. Legal wants a clear description of what "compatibility mode" means in the TOS (e.g., not a performance SLA). Also add billing note: pinned compatibility may incur a surcharge.
mike: Gating metrics proposal (concrete numbers):
- embeddings: mean cosine diff <= 0.001 on customer set AND top-10 NN rank flip rate <= 0.5%
- structured output: validator pass rate >= 99.5% on sample corpus
- tool-calls: end-to-end success rate >= 99.8% for mapped calls
- chat: no >3% drop in semantic eval score; p95 latency change <= +10% (temporary during beta)
These gates must be measured on each customer's canonical prompts, not global averages.
leah: Important: measurement tooling must be reproducible. Create a "migration-bench" job that customers can run locally (python package + docker image).
ting: Example lightweight curl migration-check (to include in docs):
```
# check embedding parity for a single item
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings/compare \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -d '{"input":"This is a test","target_model":"v1-embed","candidate_model":"v2-embed"}'
```
oliver: Ops note: add automatic fallback rule: if a customer's failure rate for any route > 2% over 5m, flip them to pinned v1 for 10 minutes and alert eng-oncall. This protects production-facing apps while we investigate.
priya: Comms plan: 1) blog outlining timeline and high-level rationale, 2) targeted emails to top customers with migration options and pricing, 3) sign-up form for assisted migration. Also schedule 2 office-hours sessions during beta.
mike: Migration SDK bits: we'll ship an "adapter" npm + pypi package that does request/response translation and exposes a validation mode. Example pseudo-call in python: 
```
from redwood_migrate import Adapter
adapter = Adapter(mode="validate")
ok, diff = adapter.compare_response(v1_resp, v2_resp)
```
leah: Rollout timeline proposal (compact):
- Week 0-2: infra + flagging + migration-bench + docs skeleton
- Week 3-6: customer beta (opt-in) + adapter GA
- Month 3-4: staged open rollout with 1% ramp/day and automated gating
- Month 6: start deprecation notices for non-pinned hosted tenants (90d migration window)
oliver: Can we include a clear cost/benefit mapping in the roadmap doc? e.g., per-customer pinned cost per month so sales can negotiate.
ting: Yes, I'll add a table in the migration doc. Also adding a small troubleshooting guide and sample git repo with conversion scripts.
ops-bot: [alert] canary: migration-adapter v0.1 deployed to staging at 2178890000
leah: Action items (owner -> due):
- oliver -> quantify infra delta for 10/50/100 pinned tenants (Fri)
- mike -> prototype SDK adapter + unit tests (next Tue)
- ting -> migration-bench + docs draft + sample scripts (next Wed)
- priya -> comms + pricing language + legal check (next Fri)
If nobody objects, we'll use this playbook to create the public migration doc and set timelines. :wave:
